test_policy_2026_27: test-optional (SAT/ACT required for homeschooled applicants; TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo for non-native English speakers)
notes: 2025-26 CDS (Fall 2025 entering class; file dated 03/30/2026, linked from the IR page). Page headers inside the PDF still read 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' (template carry-over), but the data are labelled Fall 2025. C9: 258 SAT / 54 ACT submitters of 1,513 enrolled (17% / 4% as published). C21 ED counts combine ED I (11/15) and ED II (1/15). The standard CDS does not ask for EA counts and none are published. C22 EA notification is 12/20; the admissions page gives Dec 20-Jan 15. The admissions FAQ cites Class of 2030 admitted-student middle 50% of SAT 1320-1420 and ACT 29-33 (admitted, not enrolled). The admissions page does not print a cycle year; dates are taken as current for 2026-27.

2025-26 CDS (Fall 2025). It is a fillable PDF and the checkboxes were read from the text layer. C7 'Considered' and C8A 'Yes, considered if submitted' look clear. The admissions site quotes a '2026 Admitted Student Profile' of SAT 1170-1340 and ACT 27-32 (admitted, not enrolled). stats_source: admissions site (Undergraduate Admission Facts, Fall 2026 / Class of 2030), NOT CDS
notes: I could not open the CDS. Fordham's CDS page (https://www.fordham.edu/about/leadership-and-administration/administrative-offices/office-of-the-provost/provost-office-units/institutional-research-and-assessment/consumer-information/common-data-set/) lists CDS 2024-25 as the newest. It is a OneDrive Excel share that refused anonymous download (HTML error / 403). No 2025-26 CDS is posted. All stats here come from https://www.fordham.edu/undergraduate-admission/why-fordham/admission-facts/ (Fall 2026 applications, updated Sept 23, 2026), so they are one cycle newer than any CDS. Figures: 53,599 completed applications (excludes PCS), 25,300 offers, 2,653 enrolled, acceptance rate 47%. SAT and ACT middle 50% are for ENROLLED students (SAT 1355-1470, ACT 31-34). No medians or section scores are given. 70.1% of enrollees did not submit tests, so about 29.9% submitted SAT or ACT combined; the split is not published. Admitted-student middle 50%: SAT 1380-1490, ACT 32-34 (60.3% of admits test-free). ED/EA counts and C7 test importance are not available without the CDS. Third-party sites (CollegeVine) cite the 2024-25 CDS at 43,364 applicants / 25,719 admits; this is unverified and not used. Deadlines (2026-27 cycle, explicitly dated): EA and ED I Nov 1, 2026, extended to Nov 8 this cycle; RD and ED II Jan 3, 2027.

test_policy_2026_27: test-optional (all majors; homeschooled applicants in an approved curriculum also not required)
notes: 2025-26 CDS (Fall 2025), linked as 'Fall 2025 Common Data Set' on https://www.umass.edu/uair/data/common-data-set. No ED plan (C21 = No). EA (Nov 5) is non-restrictive, and the CDS gives no EA counts. C9 inconsistency: ACT is published as 0.3% but with 160 submitters, which is 3.0% of 5,315; I used 0.030 (SAT 1,322 = 24.9% is consistent). C8E/C8D are blank. The admissions stats page shows Fall 2026: about 52.5K first-year applicants, 65% admitted, about 5.2K enrolled (newer than the CDS). The test-optional page gives no end date and no cycle year. The deadlines page also lists the spring first-year deadline as Oct 15 in one block and Nov 5 in another (inconsistent).
